basis: Explicit original printed component permissions and narrowly supplied FAQ flare clauses; no missing full-card field reconstructed.
primary_sources: Original rulebook p5 Classic Filch Wild role/phase and Cosmic Zap As Any Player
2018 FAQ p8 extraction774–784 Mite Super quoted pickup clause
2018 FAQ p6 extraction525–530 Oracle Wild hand-mixing example
2018 FAQ p16 extraction1528–1532 Loser Wild timing clause

Mite: When Mite Super's quoted pickup instruction applies, it allows taking any cards the opponent discards, not only encounter cards.
Loser: Loser Wild is played before encounter cards are selected.
Oracle: Rulebook p14; FAQ p18; FAQ p6

Against Sorcerer, foresee first: Sorcerer plays faceup, then Oracle chooses facedown; after both are selected Sorcerer can switch them. Against Gambler, Gambler must reveal or bluff before Oracle chooses. In the official Oracle Wild example, play the flare faceup in front of you outside the hands, mix the hands together, take your new hand at random from the mixed cards, then return the flare to hand when its effect finishes.
Filch: After Sorcerer switches cards, take the card ending before your opponent. Clone keeping has precedence; Filch versus Fido uses ordinary timing. You cannot take Gambler's unchallenged facedown card because it goes beneath the deck rather than to discard. The classic Filch flare is revealed only when its cheating user is caught; it may then be zapped. Its printed Wild, as any player in any phase, permits illicit warp retrieval to colonies or taking deck/discard cards; being caught costs one ship to warp and returns the items caught being filched. Once revealed, deck and discards are placed next to that player. Use only one Filch flare version. The classic Filch Super, as any player during Reveal, permits filching any other player's used encounter card whether you participated in that encounter or not.

cosmic_zap_replacement.old: **Cosmic Zap** cancels a power use, including your own, and prevents further uses for that encounter.
cosmic_zap_replacement.new: **Any player, including an uninvolved bystander, may play Cosmic Zap** on an otherwise legal power use. It cancels that use, including your own, and prevents further uses for that encounter.
